entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help. I need to... I need to return an item I bought. A VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01. I've been a loyal customer for years, I just... I really hope this isn't a problem.

Not a problem at all. Let me just pull that up. Okay, I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. I can definitely help check on the return options. First, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It works. It's just... I thought it would motivate me more, but with everything going on, it's just sitting in its box. Honestly, I really needed this money back for some other bills. I feel terrible about it.
I understand completely, things happen and we want you to be happy with your purchase. Let me just review the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I was so worried it would be too late.
Alright, I've checked for you. The purchase was made 24 days ago, and our standard return policy allows for returns within 90 days. So, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh, really? Are you sure? That's... that is such a huge relief. Thank you so much, Alex! You have no idea what a help this is.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
I see the email now. This is perfect. Thank you again, you've really turned my day around.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
